failure_evidence.summary: The configured SelfContained suite failed 88 Story 18.1 PreparedSource cases because real-root context issuance returned RootUnavailable; the same focused boundary previously passed 119/119.

proposed_changed_approach: Capture the exact failing Windows root-open step/status under a controlled reproduction, distinguish full-suite parallel/resource interference from an implementation defect, apply only the evidence-supported isolation or implementation correction, then rerun the focused PreparedSource boundary and exact configured SelfContained suite once.
recommendation: Approve a finite cumulative extension from 9 to 10 for diagnosis and one corrected verification attempt.
main_consequence: Any further substantive negative result at count 10 pauses again without another repair.
material_uncertainty: PreparedSource passes 119/119 alone but every test requiring a usable real root failed in the complete suite. The implementation currently discards the native failure status, so concurrency/resource interference is likely but not proven.
